auditor_mike: Hi team — auditor needs a concise proof-pack for the 2024-09-12 inference outage. Deliverables: KMS GenerateDataKey/Decrypt event JSONs for 02:00-06:00 UTC, a requestID->envelopeKey mapping CSV, RBAC snapshots for impacted service accounts, and a one-paragraph control mapping to SOC2/ISO controls.

sasha: Understood. Plan: export CloudTrail raw events (GenerateDataKey, Decrypt, DescribeKey), pull SIEM raw logs for correlation, snapshot RoleBindings + IAM policy attachments, and produce a small reconciliation.csv.

maria: I'll get the gitops commit range for rbac changes and run a kubectl snapshot. Commands: `git log --since="2024-09-11" --until="2024-09-13" k8s/rbac` and `kubectl get rolebinding --all-namespaces -o yaml > /tmp/rb-snap-20240912.yaml`.

opsbot: Incident INC-4312 evidence task created. Runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/forensics-collection

sasha: Note on rotations — we will NOT pause rotations. We'll snapshot and include Vault audit entries showing token/key rotation attempts. auditors asked for raw JSON; we'll put raw in evidence bucket and provide a redacted copy.

auditor_mike: Good. Also include a short statement confirming whether envelope keys are single-use and how we derive them (brief code pointer or pseudo).

sasha: Will include snippet and statement: "each GenerateDataKey call results in a unique data key ciphertext (ciphertextBlob) used per-request; we do not reuse ciphertextBlobs across requests." Will cite service code path.

maria: Evidence container will include: cloudtrail_events.json, kms_siem.json, reconciliation.csv, rolebindings_snapshot.yaml, gitops_commits.txt, vault_audit.json, README_control_map.md. ETA 5 hours.

auditor_mike: That should work. If you discover missing requestIDs or gaps in CloudTrail, call them out explicitly in README. thanks. :thumbsup:
